name: job-search
description: Six skills for running a job search the way an engineer would run an incident: evidence over optimism. hunt-sweep runs the daily ritual against a coverage ledger written before anything is read, so an unread channel forces a PARTIAL verdict instead of being reported as a quiet day; it encodes the failures that happen silently — filtering no-reply senders (where ATS decisions arrive), concluding from silence before the confirmation email, sampling threads instead of classifying them, and reporting a partial sweep as clean. ats-apply carries the widget taxonomy per ATS and the read-the-errors discipline that unlocks forms which look broken. evidence-check decides whether something actually submitted and prevents duplicate applications. role-sourcing replaces title-matching with employer-tier matching and checks req decay before a form is opened. interview-brief maps a JD's hardest requirement to one piece of proof, names the gap on purpose, and carries the list of claims that must never be made. outreach-voice keeps messages reading as a person rather than a CV in a paragraph.
